app.name: Santa
app.tagline: A group that lasts, a draw nobody can see, a wishlist per person.
signin.title: Sign in
signin.shared_device_hint: You'll be signed out when you close the browser.
signin.invalid_address: That doesn't look like an email address.
signin.too_many: Too many requests. Try again later.
code.title: Enter your code
code.link_hint: The link in the email works too.
code.wrong: Wrong code. {attempts, plural, one {# attempt left} other {# attempts left}}.
code.too_many_attempts: Too many attempts. Try again in 10 minutes.
profile.title: Your profile
profile.first_name_hint: This is the name everyone sees. A nickname like "Mamy" is fine.
participants.summary_checked: {checked, number} of {total, number} have checked their draw
edition.days_to_go: {days, plural, one {# day to go} other {# days to go}}
edition.days_ago: {days, plural, one {# day ago} other {# days ago}}
draw.changed: Your draw has changed. Press and hold to see it.
draw.relaxed: The no-repeat rule was relaxed this year.
about.body: Santa is a free, open-source app for recurring secret gift exchanges — a lasting group, one edition a year, and a draw nobody can see.
home.no_group_body: You need an invite link to join a group, or create your own.
home.none_body: Your active gift exchanges show up here. Join or create a group to get started.
create.title: Create a Secret Santa
create.error: Please check the form and try again.
create.closed: Group creation isn't open on this instance.
account.title: Account
account.delete_confirm: Delete your account? You'll leave your groups and your lists are removed. This can't be undone.
account.delete_blocked: You're the only admin of a group with other members — name another admin first.
edition.invite_hint: Share this link so your family can join.
edition.invite_qr_hint: Or scan this code to join.
edition.invite_via_group: Share the group invite to add people.
edition.run_draw_waiting: Run the draw · waiting for all
edition.draw_confirm: Draw for {n} participants? Nobody can join after this, and it cannot be undone.
edition.ready_body: The draw happens when everyone has confirmed. {confirmed, number} of {total, number} confirmed.
wishlist.banner_draft: Draft: only you can see this
wishlist.banner_published: Published: everyone here can see this
chat.locked_body: It opens when everyone has checked their draw: {n, number} to go.
join.closed: Entries are closed — the draw has run.
join.revoked: This link is no longer valid.
join.invited_body: You've been invited to join this group.
join.invited_body_private: Ask to join this group — an admin will approve you.
join.pending_body: An admin of {group} will approve you soon. You'll see the group once you're in.
settings.title: Edition settings
settings.archive_confirm: Archive this edition? Everything becomes read-only.
groups.title: Your groups
group.visibility_private_hint: People who follow the link ask to join, and you approve them.
group.visibility_semi_public_hint: Anyone with the link joins immediately — no approval needed.
group.new_edition_hint: The last edition is archived. Start the next round for this group.
wizard.restrictions_hint: Pick two people who shouldn't draw each other — e.g. a couple.
wizard.infeasible_too_few: At least 3 people need to take part.
wizard.infeasible_restrictions: These restrictions leave no possible draw — remove one, or add more people.
group.leave_confirm: Leave this group? You can be invited back later.
group.leave_err_delete_instead: You're the only member — delete the group instead.
group.leave_err_last_admin: You're the only admin — name another admin first.
group.leave_err_active_draw: You're in a draw that has already run — ask an admin to remove you.
group.delete_confirm: Type the group name “{name}” to delete it. This removes all its editions and cannot be undone.
group.delete_blocked_drawn: A group with a completed draw can't be deleted.
group.delete_err_drawn: This group has a completed draw, so it can't be deleted.
admin.title: Instance admin
admin.secrecy_note: Draws are never shown here — not who gives to whom, ever.
admin.delete_confirm: Delete the group “{name}” and all its editions? This cannot be undone.
email.signin.subject: Your sign-in code
email.signin.intro: Here is your code to sign in. It works once and expires soon.
email.signin.validity: This code is valid for 15 minutes.
email.draw_ready.subject: Your draw is ready
email.draw_ready.body: The draw has run. Open the app to discover who you're giving to.
email.chat_open.subject: The chat is open
email.chat_open.body: Everyone knows who they are giving to. The group chat is now open.
email.invitation.subject: {name} invites you to {edition}
email.invitation.body: {name} invites you to join {edition}. Tap below to take part.
email.invitation.why: You received this because someone invited you to a gift exchange.
email.new_edition.subject: A new round: {edition}
email.new_edition.body: A new edition has started: {edition}. Are you in this year?
email.draw_changed.subject: Your draw has changed
email.draw_changed.body: Someone left the exchange, so your draw has changed. Open the app to see it.
error.not_found: This page doesn't exist, or you're not a member.
error.generic: Something went wrong. Please try again.
error.session_ended: Your session ended. Please sign in again.
error.offline: You're offline. Santa needs a connection.
push.chat_body: There's a new message in the group chat.
notifications.title: Notifications
notifications.on: Notifications are on for this device.
notifications.blocked: Notifications are blocked in your browser settings.
notifications.ios_hint: On iPhone/iPad, add Santa to your Home Screen first, then open it from there to enable notifications.
notifications.error: Couldn't change notifications. Please try again.
